description.value: Treats Concession is a seasonal, takeout-only food kiosk operated within a City of New Westminster park. It serves as a convenient pit stop for cyclists passing through the park during summer months. No indoor or outdoor seating is provided, making it a grab-and-go stop.

raw_osm.name: Treats Concession
raw_osm.opening_hours: "Victoria Day Weekend to End of June: 1100-1700 weekends and public holidays; July to Labour Day: daily 1100 -  1600"
